findings.detail: prose kind names both an open-dense reading and a residual/comeager reading. They are not equivalent: residual_comeager -> open_dense_escape fails (W3: the irrationals are comeager with empty interior), so a class quantified over the residual set differs from one quantified over an open dense set. af_scc_c0_vacuum.yaml itself distinguishes them ('open dense only' is strictly weaker), so the drafts are mutually inconsistent about the notion.

block distinguishes the topology in which the set is open from the topology in which it is dense; no single genericity_kind token expresses this, so the schema must declare both topologies explicitly or the vocabulary must be extended by the owner

schema denies a transfer that is definitional: an open dense set is a countable intersection of open dense sets (itself), so it is comeager. Witness text 'open dense does not imply comeager' is false as stated.
